players.product: Coolinside full-chain liquid cooling for AI servers and data centers (cold plates, UQD/MQD quick disconnects, manifolds, CDUs, coolant) plus data-center room and cabinet cooling

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 6,067,759,091.55, up 32.23% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 521,914,773.00, up 15.30%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 503,698,695.52, up 17.22%; operating cash flow RMB 157,273,222.36, down 21.30%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 932,585,781.26, Q2 RMB 1,640,553,679.64, Q3 RMB 1,452,891,317.45, Q4 RMB 2,041,728,313.20; quarterly net profit: Q1 RMB 48,010,475.41, Q2 RMB 167,629,951.15, Q3 RMB 183,429,234.55, Q4 RMB 122,845,111.89. Gross margin 27.86% (down 0.89 points). The company says data-center demand grew fast and liquid-cooling adoption kept advancing, while energy-storage demand recovered amid continued competition; results set a record, extending a 10-plus-year run of revenue and profit growth.

Segments and regions (annual report, FY2025): data-center room cooling products RMB 3,448,477,492.62, 56.83% of revenue, up 41.28%, gross margin 28.36% (up 1.39 points) - growth slowed in H2 versus H1, H2 2025 overseas room-cooling revenue rose significantly, and H2 and full-year margins were significantly higher than a year earlier; cabinet cooling products RMB 1,977,423,139.19, up 15.30%, gross margin 27.24% (down 4.24 points on regional revenue mix); energy-storage applications about RMB 17 hundred million, up about 14%; 'other' (incl. electronics / server liquid cooling) RMB 506,679,178.72, up 105.18%; bus air-conditioning RMB 90,266,641.17 (down 18.86%); rail transit RMB 44,912,639.85 (down 39.84%). Domestic revenue RMB 5,218,569,309.69 (up 32.82%, gross margin 23.83%); overseas revenue RMB 849,189,781.86 (up 28.70%, 14.00% of revenue, gross margin 52.64%).
quarterly_data.figure: Room cooling RMB 3,448,477,492.62 (+41.28%); other incl. electronics cooling RMB 506,679,178.72 (+105.18%); overseas RMB 849,189,781.86 (+28.70%)

quarterly_data.signal: Volumes (annual report, FY2025): precision temperature-control equipment sales volume 324,058 units (up 25.64%), output 321,275 units (up 21.41%), year-end inventory 26,365 units (down 9.55%). In 2025 the company launched new products including the XStorm thin fan wall.

Named data-center customers (annual report): the company sells directly or through system integrators to data-center owners, IDC operators, large internet companies and telecom operators, and says that over the years it has supplied large volumes of efficient cooling products and systems for the large data centers of ByteDance, Tencent, Alibaba, Qinhuai Data, GDS, AtHub, China Mobile and China Telecom; in some projects it also provides modular data-center systems and turnkey integration. In telecom cabinet cooling it names Huawei and ZTE as long-standing customers.
Top five customers (annual report): combined sales RMB 1,177,849,384.43, 19.41% of 2025 sales; listed shares 5.24%, 4.11%, 3.93%, 3.24% and 2.89%; names not disclosed; related-party share 0.00%.

quarterly_data.signal: Top five suppliers (annual report): combined purchases RMB 595,103,403.01, 15.18% of 2025 purchases; listed shares 3.78%, 3.65%, 3.48%, 2.22% and 2.05%; names not disclosed; related-party share 0.00%. Direct materials were 80.48% of operating cost.
quarterly_data.figure: Top five suppliers 15.18% of 2025 purchases; largest 3.78%

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D spend RMB 445,940,662.45 in 2025, up 27.51%, 7.35% of revenue, none capitalised; R&D staff 1,959 (up 12.20%), 34.39% of employees. Liquid-cooling R&D projects: a next-generation high-cooling-density CDU for next-generation high-density compute equipment (development stage); a two-phase cold-plate system for next-generation high-density compute (development stage); high-density single-phase cold plates (pre-research); DN50-and-above large-bore stainless-steel quick-plug connectors for liquid-cooling piping (small-trial stage); a fluid-corrosion test platform for long-term testing of its SoluKing coolant (development stage).

Construction in progress (annual report): RMB 268,132,326.74 at end-2025 (RMB 164,244,648.99 at end-2024). Central China (Zhongyuan) headquarters base for precision temperature-control equipment: budget RMB 350,000,000.00, cumulative spend 84.11% of budget, progress 90.92%; South China headquarters base completed (100%) and RMB 44,023,018.87 transferred to fixed assets; South China headquarters base phase 3: budget RMB 129,811,717.96, progress 2.91%; R&D center and production base (Shenzhen): budget RMB 604,045,012.00, progress 0.46%. New subsidiaries Envicool (Thailand) Co., Ltd. (July 2, 2025) and PT Envicool Technology Indonesia (November 19, 2025) were set up.
quarterly_data.figure: CIP RMB 268,132,326.74; Zhongyuan base budget RMB 350,000,000.00, 90.92% complete

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company guidance): relying on domestic bases in Zhongshan, Suzhou and Zhengzhou and overseas bases in Thailand and the US, it will upgrade its global supply chain and expand overseas engineering and service capacity to meet large customers' requirements on quality, capacity scale and delivery. It will push liquid-cooled AI compute centers and liquid-cooled servers to meet the AI infrastructure build-out, keep expanding in the overseas AI liquid-cooling compute market and work with mainstream customers across the chain to reach business scale; aim to regain global market share in energy-storage thermal management; and seize the liquid-cooling window to reach scale application of electronics cooling in servers, switches, RF antennas and power conversion, linking R&D, capacity expansion and customer development.
